import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants (trim leading/trailing spaces)
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    
    # Fix island label variants (normalize case)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.lower().str.title()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g from text to numeric (remove commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Convert year to numeric
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    # Group by species and calculate mean body_mass_g
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
